- Lesions appear on multiple leaflets; some have coalesced into larger irregular patches
- Angular shape suggesting vein-delimited lesions

**Key distinguishing features:**
- The yellowish-green halos around dark brown lesion centers are the hallmark of **Bacterial_Blight**
- Angular lesions consistent with water-soaked bacterial infection delimited by leaf veins
- Lesions coalescing into larger irregular areas — described in Bacterial_Blight
- Mid-canopy location matches (Bacterial_Blight is most common on young leaves in mid to upper canopy)

The Bacterial_Blight reference collage confirms the pattern: angular spots with yellow halos on young/mid-canopy leaflets, which closely matches the test image.
